preTest.title: Pre-study knowledge check
preTest.description: Answer these questions individually before your group begins. There are no wrong answers — this helps measure learning gains.

options: Working alone on the same assignment
Learning through joint engagement and shared responsibility among group members
Having an AI complete tasks for the group
Competing against other groups for the highest score

questions.text: In educational scaffolding, the AI agent should primarily:
options: Provide final answers so the group can move on quickly
Replace group discussion when members disagree
Support the group's thinking without taking over the task
Grade the group's work automatically

questions.text: A guiding question from an AI tutor is meant to:
options: State the correct answer directly
Prompt the group to reason further without giving the solution
Summarize the entire discussion
Split tasks among group members

questions.text: When a group receives AI feedback on a draft answer, they should:
options: Copy the AI text as their final answer
Use the feedback to revise their own reasoning together
Ignore it and submit the draft unchanged
Ask the AI for a full answer instead

questions.text: Learner autonomy in AI-supported collaboration means:
options: The AI decides what support the group needs
The group chooses when and what type of AI support to use
Students work without any group interaction
The researcher selects scaffolding for each scenario

postTest.title: Post-study knowledge check
postTest.description: Answer these questions individually after completing all scenarios. Your responses help measure what you learned during the activity.

questions.text: Which scaffolding type is best when a group has lost track of their discussion?
options: Full expert answer
Summary of discussion
Task splitting
No assistance

questions.text: Why might providing a full expert answer be risky in collaborative learning?
options: It takes too long to generate
It can reduce group reasoning and create over-reliance on AI
Groups cannot read long responses
It is never useful for comparison

questions.text: Conflict support scaffolding should help a group:
options: Pick the majority opinion automatically
Compare ideas respectfully using shared criteria
End the discussion immediately
Remove dissenting members from the task

questions.text: Effective group collaboration with AI means:
options: Letting AI autopilot while members watch
Using AI to support discussion while the group retains agency
Avoiding all AI support
Each member requesting different scaffolding types

questions.text: After receiving a hint or guiding question, a group should:
options: Submit the AI text as their final answer
Build on the prompt through further discussion
Request full answer scaffolding next
Skip to the next scenario
